snippet.title: A Game About Digging For Worms — Co-op Trailer
snippet.description:
Dig for worms — now with friends! 

A Game About Digging For Worms is a cozy digging game with CO-OP MULTIPLAYER. Grab a shovel, a drill or even a cannon, dig deep under the garden, find rare worms and sell them to the old sailor. Fly out of the pit on a propeller hat… and watch out for friendly fire!

⭐ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5518400/


#indiegame #coop #steam
